name: Occidental Petroleum of Qatar — directional casing while drilling at Idd Shargi North Dome (offshore Qatar)
description: 12-1/4-in. horizontal production and injection wells landed up to 86 deg inclination into the top of the Shuaiba, with 9-5/8-in. casing drilled and set through the unstable Nahr Umr shale

sources.note: Offshore magazine, Directional Casing while Drilling eases path through Nahr Umr shale off Qatar, September 2009 (read 28 October 2026)
